title: Review of c46's hunting ecology: S, I, X and predator D replicate on fresh seed 61 (256^2, with matched twin) and the prey's fuel dependence on seed 62, but D is the predators' and E the prey's, and both kinds' E is written into their rules
summary: Labkit re-run of the claim's world.py unchanged at 256^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5, fresh seed 61, with the matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0), and the claim's fuel fork (fork_t 6000, drive.py) with its fed twin on fresh seed 62 at 128^2. Prey form from noise (49-52 by t=1000); predator noise added at t=2000 condenses into 50-58 droplets; prey fall to 5 near t=3000, recover to 54 by t=5000-6000 and fall to 15-20 by t=12000, while the twin's prey grow 52 -> 78. Predators: 11 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.09; free predator droplets elongate into rods and Y-shapes that break (sheet t=8900-11000). Prey persistent splits 2 with predators against 25 in the twin. Fork on seed 62: prey 12 -> 0 by t=6800 after the fuel cut with prey material kept (mean 0.236 -> 0.229); fed twin 12 -> 10.

observations.S: rerun/seed61/sheet.png: t=0 smooth noise of prey material; prey condensates by t=500; the predator noise added at t=2000 condenses into droplets by t=2600.
observations.I: rerun/seed61/sheet.png: discrete round prey condensates (cyan) and small predator droplets (orange) throughout; prey species 10 persistent tracks.
observations.X: rerun/seed61 vs twin/seed61 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, window): prey species counts every 1000 t with predators 13, 49, 52, 5, 19, 54, 54, 45, 28, 19, 22, 20, 15; twin 5, 49, 52, 52, 53, 53, 53, 53, 55, 60, 71, 77, 78. Prey persistent splits 2 with predators vs 25 in the twin. Predators crash the prey, let them recover and hold them low; sign negative for the prey.
observations.D: rerun/seed61: predator species 35 splits, 11 persistent (K=5), generation 2 from the t=2000 noise, merge/split 0.09; sheet t=8900-11000 shows free predator rods and Y-shapes breaking into separate droplets. Predator D only: the prey divide twice.
observations.E: efork/fork_s62.json and fork_s62.png vs fed_s62 (fresh seed 62, 128^2, fork_t 6000): prey bodies 12 at the fork, 6 at +200 t, 1 at +600 t, 0 at +800 t, as a diffuse haze of conserved prey material; fed 11-12 to +400 t and 10 at +1000 t (some eaten). Prey E only.

seeds_run.result: pass for S, I, X and predator D (11 persistent splits, generation 2)
prey fuel fork: 12 -> 0 prey within 800 t, fed twin 10-12

verdicts.limitation: The capabilities sit on different kinds: D is carried by the predators (the prey divide 2 times against 25 in the twin) and E by the prey, so no individual shows I, X, D and E together; I list them as seen and judge the claim Weak for that reason. E for the prey holds by construction in the same sense as c62's predators: the prey's miscibility gap is written to open only with its fuel-made product (r = -r0 + alpha p), so cutting the fuel removes the term that makes the body cohere; the predators are made only from prey material (by construction, as the claim says). One fresh seed at 256^2 and one fork seed at 128^2.
